title: Field tech test script
who: You are Peter Kamau, a field tech in Zuri A. Everything is pretend and stays on your phone.

sessions.title: Your jobs, start to finish
sessions.intro: Open a job, start it, finish it with cash and with M-Pesa — and see what Zuri says when something is missing.

steps.do: Tap 🧹 Start over (pretend company), then tap OK.
steps.see: The page reloads. The Me page shows Peter Kamau · Field tech. (Now you have the same pretend jobs as everyone else.)

steps.do: Look at the bottom of your phone screen (on a computer or a wide window, look at the left side instead). Tap each tab once: Jobs, Tasks, Me.
steps.see: Three tabs. Jobs says “My jobs”. Tasks says “Hi Peter”. Me shows your name.

steps.do: Tap 🔴 John Mwangi #101.
steps.see: “Job #101 · Fault / no internet” opens. The problem says “No internet since morning — router light is red”.

steps.do: In job #101 (open it if it isn't open): tap 📞 Call — your phone offers to call. Press Cancel, it is a pretend number. Then tap 🗺️ Open map, look, and come back to Zuri.
steps.see: The phone shows the customer's number ready to call. The map opens at the customer's house.

steps.do: In job #101: tap ▶ I'm starting now.
steps.see: “Saved.” flashes. The label near the top changes from Assigned to In progress.

steps.do: In job #101: under “What did you find?” tap Router off / faulty. Under “What did you do?” tap Restarted router and Tested — working. Under “Did the customer pay you?” tap 💵 Cash and type 3000. Tap ✅ Job finished.
steps.see: The label changes to Done. Under NOTES there is a line “Job done · collected KES 3,000 (cash)”.

steps.do: Open Samuel Kibet #102. Without tapping anything else, tap ✅ Job finished.
steps.see: A message: “Tap or write what you did, then press Job finished.” The job stays open (still Assigned).
auto: Tap or write what you did, then press Job finished.

steps.do: In job #102: under “What did you do?” tap Fixed settings. Tap 📱 M-Pesa and type 2000. Leave the M-Pesa code empty and tap ✅ Job finished.
steps.see: A message asks for the M-Pesa code: “Add the M-Pesa code from the customer's message…”. Nothing is saved yet.
auto: Add the M-Pesa code from the customer's message

steps.do: Still in job #102 (if you left it, open it and tap Fixed settings, 📱 M-Pesa, 2000 again): type the code UJ7K2M9PQR in “M-Pesa code”. Tap ✅ Job finished.
steps.see: The label changes to Done. NOTES says “Job done · collected KES 2,000 (mpesa)”.

steps.do: On My jobs, tap Done (at the top, next to To do). Look, then tap To do to go back.
steps.see: Under Done: John Mwangi #101 and Samuel Kibet #102, both marked Done. Under To do: Lucy Atieno #103 is left.

sessions.title: Parts, photos, pins, new jobs and tasks
sessions.intro: The extras on a job, logging a job yourself, your task list, and working with no signal.

steps.do: Open Lucy Atieno #103 (tap To do at the top if you can't see it). Under PARTS & EQUIPMENT USED type Item: ONT router, Serial: HWT12345678, Qty: 1. Tap Add.
steps.see: “ONT router” appears in the parts list with the serial HWT12345678.

steps.do: In job #103: tap 📷 Add photo. Take a photo of anything (or pick one) and use it.
steps.see: “Photo saved” flashes and the photo shows under PHOTOS.

steps.do: In job #103: at the bottom, type “Customer not home, back at 2pm” in Add a note. Tap Add.
steps.see: Your note shows under NOTES with your name, Peter Kamau.

steps.do: Go outside if you can. In job #103: tap 📍 Move pin to here. Tap OK, and Allow if the phone asks to use your location.
steps.see: “Pin saved (accurate to about … m)”. If the phone says the pin is rough, it asks you to step outside and try again — that is correct too.
steps.tip: Indoors the phone can be 100 m off. Zuri warns you so the next tech isn't sent to the wrong house.

steps.do: On “Log a job”: Type of job: Fault / no internet. What's wrong: “Pole down near the school, 3 houses off”. Caller: “Mama Ann 0712 000 333”. Tap Save job.
steps.copy: Pole down near the school, 3 houses off
steps.see: “Job saved.” The new job opens. Back on My jobs it is in your list for today.
auto: Pole down near the school, 3 houses off

steps.do: On Tasks → My day, find “Check the splitter box at the market”. Tap 💬 Notes under it, type “Checked — all fine”, tap Add.
steps.see: Your note shows under the task.
look: Check the splitter box at the market

steps.do: Tick the box next to “Check the splitter box at the market”.
steps.see: “Done ✓” flashes and the task is ticked.
look: Check the splitter box at the market
auto: input[aria-label='Done: Check the splitter box at the market']

steps.do: On ＋ Add a task: What needs doing? “Bring 2 connectors to the market box”. Who should do it? Brian Otieno. Tap Add task.
steps.copy: Bring 2 connectors to the market box
steps.see: “Task added.” Tap Team: the task is there, for Brian Otieno.
auto: Bring 2 connectors to the market box
Bring 2 connectors to the market box

steps.do: Turn on airplane mode. Open Lucy Atieno #103 (tap To do at the top if you can't see it) and add the note “Testing with no signal”. Then turn airplane mode off and wait a few seconds.
steps.see: With no signal the note shows “⏳ not sent” and a yellow badge appears at the top. When signal is back, the badge clears by itself.

sessions.title: Receipts
sessions.intro: Spent Zuri money on a job? Snap the receipt or paste the M-Pesa message — that's all.

steps.do: Open Lucy Atieno #103 (tap To do at the top if you can't see it). Under 🧾 Spent money on this job? tap 📸 Snap the receipt. Then tap 🖼️ From my photos and pick any photo (or 📸 Take a photo of any paper).
steps.see: “🧾 Snap a receipt” opens with “For job #103 · Lucy Atieno” on top. Your photo shows, and Zuri says “Type the details — reading is switched off.”
auto: Type the details — reading is switched off.

steps.do: Still on that receipt (if you left, do step 1 again): Paid to: Kamau Hardware. Amount: 850. What was it for: Equipment / Inventory. Paid with: 💵 Cash. Tap ✅ Save.
steps.see: “✅ Saved — the photo is uploading.” Zuri takes you back to job #103.

steps.do: On 🧾 Snap a receipt tap 📩 Paste M-Pesa message. Copy the message below, paste it in the box and tap Read the message. What was it for: Equipment / Inventory. Tap ✅ Save.
steps.copy: UKF1RCPT01 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh40,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: Before saving, the boxes fill themselves: Kamau Hardware, 1200, today's date, code UKF1RCPT01. After ✅ Save: “✅ Saved.”
auto: UKF1RCPT01 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh40,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: Tap 📩 Paste M-Pesa message again, paste the SAME message and tap Read the message. Don't save.
steps.copy: UKF1RCPT01 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh40,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.
steps.see: A red warning: “⚠️ Already recorded: KES 1,200 to Kamau Hardware…”, so it isn't counted twice.
auto: UKF1RCPT01 Confirmed. Ksh1,200.00 paid to KAMAU HARDWARE. on {dmy} at 10:15 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh40,800.00. Transaction cost, Ksh0.00.

steps.do: On 🧾 My receipts, find Kamau Hardware 3,850 marked ❌ (no receipt). Tap 📸 Snap it now and pick any photo.
steps.see: “📷 Receipt saved — uploading.” Back on My receipts, that one now shows 📷 instead of ❌.
